events.event_name: DISCOVER SHIYENZE | Fashion Week Open Atelier
events.what_it_is: A three-day open atelier during NYFW with designer Roselyne Shiyenze, one-of-one pieces, textiles, styling, shopping, Kenyan tea and wine.
events.what_is_free: Admission is free with RSVP. The event description also advertises Kenyan tea and wine as part of the atelier experience; merchandise is for sale.
events.caveats: The organizer's Eventbrite page explicitly says free with RSVP. No host-approval step is stated, so this is classified as Free RSVP rather than Approval Required.
events.practical_notes: Friday September 11 from 5–9 PM, Saturday September 12 from 12–8 PM, and Sunday September 13 from 12–6 PM at 87 George Street in Bushwick.

events.event_name: Mary Kay Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared Pop-Up
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A one-day oversized beauty activation at Gansevoort Plaza tied to Mary Kay's Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared campaign, with product giveaways, beauty touch-ups and interactive photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Public access plus advertised free full-size Mary Kay products while supplies last. Current listings describe the event as free and open to the public.
events.caveats: Two current event sources agree that the activation is open to the public. Product quantities are promotional inventory and should be treated as while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza. No advance RSVP or approval requirement is established by the verified sources.

events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A branded NYFW truck celebrating eos Dewy Lip Shine with product sampling, sweet treats, photo moments and shade discovery.
events.what_is_free: Public access with advertised Dewy Lip Shine sampling and sweet treats. Promotional inventory remains subject to availability.
events.caveats: Two current event sources agree on the date, hours, address and open-to-public access. Samples and treats are promotional inventory and are not guaranteed to every attendee.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway in SoHo. No advance RSVP or approval requirement is published.

events.event_name: Hempz × Ulta Beauty Serene Waters Pop-Up
events.address: Ulta Beauty, 2 Herald Square, 1328 Broadway, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A one-day Hempz pop-up at Ulta Beauty centered on the Serene Waters Magnesium Body Lotion, with an outdoor beverage truck and additional on-site surprises.
events.what_is_free: The pop-up is described as open to the public. A separate organizer Eventbrite listing confirms the activation and beverage truck; purchase-linked gifts apply to the meet-and-greet portion, not general admission.
events.caveats: The general pop-up is listed as open to the public from 12:30–6:30 PM. The separate 4–6:30 PM Tonya Michelle meet-and-greet advertises gifts with purchase, so those purchase-linked gifts are not represented as general freebies.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12:30–6:30 PM at Ulta Beauty Herald Square. No general advance RSVP or approval requirement is established.

events.address: Century 21 NYC, 22 Cortlandt St, New York, NY 10007
events.what_it_is: A two-day in-store Fashion Week runway where anyone can walk, be filmed for Century 21 social stories, and receive event giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Century 21's official page says every walker receives a free tote, up to five iron-on patches and a $21-off-$100 in-store card; totes and patches are while supplies last.
events.caveats: The official Century 21 page explicitly says there is no ticket, invitation, registration or online sign-up. Walking the runway means being filmed for the store's Instagram and TikTok stories. Totes and patches are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 and Wednesday, September 16 from 12–6 PM on the main floor, Dey Street side. Get in line on site; no advance registration is needed.
